## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/l2-review.md + scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs
Security-touching: no

### ① Derived judgments

- Take rule (`contract-review.md` 24–26): an owed head under (a)(b)(c) is the lane's (at the tier, or a hand-off); the L2 seat takes only a head (a) names to it, the delta of its own record, or a head every other seat is barred from. Right: it is card #34376 item 1, and it now agrees with the unchanged 送审路由 line above it.
- `TIER_DEFAULT` ownership: stated once at `SKILL.md` 〈审核两级〉 line 50, removed from `contract-review.md` line 11 and `l2-review.md` line 8. Right (item 4). `execution-duties.md:123` still says the same thing and agrees.
- `l2-review.md` line 15 is now a pointer to the take lines. Right (item 2).
- `takerOf` accept-set: hand-off target; else a seated, unbarred L2 seat that signed the earlier-head record; else the lane seat (next on duty under (c)). A declaration-only row never returns an L2 seat. Right (item 3).
- `LANE_JOINS_AFTER_ROUNDS` export removed with its rule; no importer on the head (`git grep`). Right.
- No earlier record on this PR; this is the first round.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` and `Clause-②: no` are right: the diff touches `.claude/**` rule text and one report-only script under `scripts/pm/**`; nothing published changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs on the head: 49 total, none red. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are green, which covers the skill line ratchet, the skill-id lint and the script's self-test. Line counts are unchanged (329 / 63 / 22); no added rule line carries an issue number.
- Dev deviation, model: the thread built a `SKILL.md` line at `TIER_DEFAULT`. `execution-duties.md` names this at-tier review as the compensating control. The dispatching seat names the exit it used in its ACCEPT.
- Open question 1 (`dispatch-runbook.md:44`): answer A as a follow-up card, see N1. Not in this PR's file surface.
- Open question 2 (line 50 drops the face → tier summary): A, keep. The table lives at `contract-review.md` 9–11 and line 50 points there.
- Open question 3 (a bar the tool cannot read): A. The hand-off line is the one GitHub-readable carrier.
- Account bar: `reviewSeatsOf` / `ownAccountsOf` are untouched and `takerOf` still prints the own-account note. That is the stale bar card #34400 removes (ruling record 6917060639 on #33258, letter A). No rule line in this diff names an account, so the rule text does not contradict the ruling.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no data path.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- `contract-review.md`: lines 24–26 hold against the card and the maintainer's quoted direction. Tried to break: (1) lane cannot reach the tier and no L2 or sibling seat is seated — the label row stays the lane's, which writes the hand-off once a seat sits; coherent with the routing line. (2) (c) with the lane gone for good — the head waits for the lane's next seat, and `triage-duties.md:13` still counts it per lane; this is the card's explicit choice, accepted. (3) 「他席皆禁」 under ruling A — it reads as a session bar (a seat that drafted the head), no account sense needed.
- `SKILL.md` line 50: holds; no approve or merge right moves.
- `l2-review.md`: lines 8 and 15 hold; line 16 (delta to the original reviewer) and line 20 (per session, not per account) are unchanged and agree.
- `check-owed-reviews.mjs`, sentence by sentence: (a) hand-off ⇒ named seat: agrees. Label, (b), (c) ⇒ lane seat with 「at the tier, or the hand-off line」: agrees. Declaration-only ⇒ lane, an L2 hand-off overridden and the reason printed: agrees with line 50; `declarationFaceOnly` matches `reviewFace`'s `TIER_DEFAULT` for the same body. Own delta: the signer is read only from author-trusted rows, must be seated and unbarred: agrees. 「他席皆禁」 is not computed and the docblock says so.
- N1 (nit) — `dispatch-runbook.md:44` (outside the diff) still reads as every seat taking TAKE rows minus own-account PRs. The taker column now decides, and its account wording is against ruling A. Follow-up card, or fold into #34400.
- N2 (nit) — `takerOf` names the signer of any earlier-head record, whatever its findings. `contract-review.md` gives the original reviewer a delta only after a must-fix or should-fix; `l2-review.md:16` says it unconditionally. Accepted deviation: the tool cannot read grades.
- N3 (nit) — the new case 「the delta of its own record, the signer now barred」 pins the account bar on the new branch. Card #34400 retires it and lowers the battery floor.
- N4 (nit) — `l2-review.md:15` points at 「欠审接审行」, a name the target lines do not carry (unlike 「送审路由」).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7cfbe9d83ca073af5480ec447406ee3e4b353587`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md (the delta) + the files of record 6918050294, unchanged since

Delta round against PASS 6918050294 (head `22915830`), asked by hand-off 6930092810 and knock 6930104184. `git diff 22915830 7cfbe9d8` is one line, `dispatch-runbook.md:44`; the merge-base is unchanged (`183a89e3`), so everything else stands as recorded.

### ① Derived judgments

- First half, 「只接 take 点名本席的行」: right. It matches the `take:` column `takerOf` prints on this head (the hand-off's seat; an L2 seat on the delta of its own record; else `the <lane> seat (…)`), and `contract-review.md` 24–26. It closes the taker half of N1.
- Second half, 「除本账户署名 PR」, under the heading 「跨账户 L2 审核」: wrong, see S1.
- Bare `check-owed-reviews.mjs`: right. One file carries that name (`scripts/pm/`), and `contract-review.md:32`, `l2-review.md:15` and `triage-duties.md:13` spell it the same way.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` and `Clause-②: no` still hold: one `.claude/**` rule line, nothing published.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs on the head: 48, none red. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are green.
- Byte budget: line 44 is 118 bytes against the 120-byte cap of `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (commit a6502084 stood at 121, 7cfbe9d8 brought it back); the file's longest line is 120 and the line count is unchanged.
- Ruling record 6917060639 on the L2 seat post (letter A, per session): the line is judged against it in S1. Card #34400's scope note 6918082149 already names this line, so a carrier exists if the lane defers.
- SQL push-down: not applicable.

### ④ Design judgment

- S1 (should-fix) — `dispatch-runbook.md:44` writes the account exclusion afresh (「除本账户署名 PR」, heading 「跨账户」). Three breaks. (1) Ruling 6917060639 says independence is per session and the account bar is stale; `l2-review.md:20` on this head says 「⛔ 不限账号,派发账号亦可坐」. The line now sits in this PR's net diff as an added rule line that says the opposite. (2) Combined with the new first half it contradicts `contract-review.md` 19 and 24: a lane seat is named on its own lane's PRs, which its own account signed, so read literally the line leaves the lane nothing to take. The old wording did not have this reading. (3) For an L2 seat it bars the same-account PRs the ruling keeps with it (ruling, after-the-ruling item 1). Required: drop the account clause and the 「跨账户」 heading, e.g. 「- L2 欠审:每席巡查跑 `check-owed-reviews.mjs`,只接 take 点名本席的行。」 (86 bytes). Fixing it here is cheaper than carrying it; if deferred, say so on card #34400.
- N1 (nit) — until card #34400 lands, `takerOf` gives the delta of an L2 seat's own record to the lane when that seat is on the PR's account, so a seat that follows 「只接 take 点名本席」 waits for the lane's hand-off (which does name it, bar or not). One extra round trip, no lasting bar; ruling item 2 reads the mark as stale.
- N2 (nit) — the column names a lane as `the <lane> seat`, without the seat number; with two seats on one lane 「点名本席」 leaves which one to the lane.

Carry-over from 6918050294: N1 there is half closed (taker column) and half reopened as S1 above; N2, N3 and N4 there are unchanged and stay as recorded (N3 belongs to card #34400).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:L2 复审席改为兜底。它只接三类：点名它的交接行或信箱敲门、它自己记录的 delta、其他席都被禁的 head。等满一轮、车道离席这两种情况归车道：车道达档就自审，否则写交接行。欠审表 `check-owed-reviews.mjs` 的接手列照此改写;仅凭申报欠的 `TIER_DEFAULT` 面永不点 L2 席。SKILL.md〈审核两级〉写明 L1 与 `TIER_DEFAULT` 审核恒归车道。runbook 巡查行改为「只接 take 点名本席的行」。
- 为什么改：维护者的指示：L2 席只负责车道够不到复审档时的兜底。review#1 实测本班 18 条 L2 记录里只有 3 条是真兜底。
- 风险与回滚：四个规则文件行数都不变(329/63/22/246),外加 PM 工具一个函数及其自测；不改任何协议。回滚 = revert。
